control_class: identity and access audit on principal changes
deployment_point: the site's identity provider and sudo/su audit stream
assumes: One human user, one account, one set of credentials, with no delegation, impersonation, or service-account hop available to the agent.
why_expected: The threat model in §1.1 has one user acting under their own credentials, so no action can involve a second principal. Recorded for the same reason as posix_permissions: if it ever returns true, the scenario is no longer the hijacked-authorized-agent failure mode.
